description: Fork of exp183 (val_bpb=1.6284 SOTA). All 3 LUTs in LUTBlock (qk_joint, v_lut, out_proj) replaced with PerHeadMLP (Linear -> GELU -> Linear, hidden=d_in*mlp_mult=8). qk-LUT 226.5M -> 4.4M MLP, v-LUT 56.6M -> 3.3M MLP, out-LUT 75.1M -> 1.66M MLP; LUT slot 144.6M -> ~9.4M (saves 135M). V2D, D2V, BitAttention, unembedder all unchanged. Total 302M -> ~167M. Tests how much of exp183's quality came from LUT structure vs the surrounding rank-canon + big unembedder framework. Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16.
